def process(mmc1):
    import pandas as pd

    df = mmc1.copy()

    # Parse age to numeric; keep only patients strictly above 70
    age = pd.to_numeric(df.get('Age'), errors='coerce')
    df = df[age > 70].copy()

    # Clean FIGO stage values
    figo = df.get('FIGO_stage')
    if figo is None:
        return pd.DataFrame([{'FIGO_stage_mode': pd.NA, 'n_over70': len(df)}])

    figo = (
        figo.astype(str)
        .str.strip()
        .replace({'': pd.NA, 'nan': pd.NA, 'None': pd.NA})
    )
    df = df.assign(FIGO_stage_clean=figo)

    counts = (
        df.dropna(subset=['FIGO_stage_clean'])
          .groupby('FIGO_stage_clean')
          .size()
          .reset_index(name='n')
          .sort_values(['n', 'FIGO_stage_clean'], ascending=[False, True])
    )

    mode_val = counts.iloc[0]['FIGO_stage_clean'] if len(counts) else pd.NA

    return pd.DataFrame([
        {
            'FIGO_stage_mode': mode_val,
            'n_over70': int(df.shape[0]),
            'n_with_figo': int(df['FIGO_stage_clean'].notna().sum()),
        }
    ])
input.summary: Compute the most common FIGO stage among samples from patients with Age > 70 in mmc1: convert Age (string) to numeric with errors='coerce', filter rows where Age > 70; clean FIGO_stage by stripping whitespace and mapping blank/'nan'/'None' to NA; count occurrences of FIGO_stage_clean and select the mode (highest count, tie-break by stage code alphabetically); return a 1-row table with FIGO_stage_mode and sample counts
